layers.title: Average sunlight
layers.description: Fraction of time the Sun is visible above the local terrain horizon (multi-year average).
layers.source: LOLA / Mazarico et al., AVGVISIB 85S 60 m (PDS)

layers.title: Average Earth visibility
layers.description: Fraction of time the Earth is above the local terrain horizon: direct-to-Earth comms.
layers.source: LOLA / Mazarico et al., AVGVISIB_EARTH 85S 60 m (PDS)

layers.title: Permanent shadow (PSR)
layers.description: Permanently shadowed regions: never lit, extremely cold, possible water ice.

layers.title: Slope
layers.description: Surface slope from LOLA topography. Landers typically need < 8–15°.

layers.title: Elevation
layers.description: Height above the 1737.4 km reference sphere. Also used in the browser to compute horizons for custom sites.
layers.source: LOLA LDEM 80S 80 m (PDS), resampled to 240 m

layers.title: Mean surface charging potential
layers.description: Mean EQUIPOT surface potential over sampled SPICE epochs; DEM-derived normals, flat local horizon.
layers.source: EQUIPOT/SPENVIS + LOLA DEM + NASA SPICE (3653 epochs, every 12 h)

layers.title: Minimum surface charging potential
layers.description: Minimum EQUIPOT surface potential over sampled SPICE epochs; DEM-derived normals, flat local horizon.
layers.source: EQUIPOT/SPENVIS + LOLA DEM + NASA SPICE (3653 epochs, every 12 h)

layers.title: Time below -100 V
layers.description: Fraction of sampled epochs with EQUIPOT potential below -100 V; DEM-derived normals, flat local horizon.
layers.source: EQUIPOT/SPENVIS + LOLA DEM + NASA SPICE (3653 epochs, every 12 h)

layers.title: Mean regolith temperature
layers.description: Mean 1D regolith surface temperature; equilibrium estimate outside selected thermal sites.
layers.source: Hayne 2017 regolith model + LOLA + NASA SPICE (2922 post-spin-up epochs, mode=sites, 7 regolith points, 731 spin-up steps)

layers.title: Minimum regolith temperature
layers.description: Minimum 1D regolith surface temperature; equilibrium estimate outside selected thermal sites.
layers.source: Hayne 2017 regolith model + LOLA + NASA SPICE (2922 post-spin-up epochs, mode=sites, 7 regolith points, 731 spin-up steps)

layers.title: Maximum regolith temperature
layers.description: Maximum 1D regolith surface temperature; equilibrium estimate outside selected thermal sites.
layers.source: Hayne 2017 regolith model + LOLA + NASA SPICE (2922 post-spin-up epochs, mode=sites, 7 regolith points, 731 spin-up steps)

layers.title: Earth visibility (80S, terrain horizon)
layers.description: Fraction of time the Earth disc is above the local terrain horizon (LOLA DEM + SPICE); direct-to-Earth comms. Covers 80S-90S, unlike the 85S LOLA product.
layers.source: LOLA DEM (dem_south.png, 240 m; global LDEM tiles beyond 80S) + NASA SPICE (7305 epochs every 6 h, 2026-01-01 onward), observer 2 m
